title: Three killed in Israeli strike on vehicle bearing World Central Kitchen logo
detail: A news report on Nov 23 says three people were killed in an Israeli strike on a vehicle bearing the World Central Kitchen logo in Gaza. Only the headline was available at the time of writing; details, victims' identities and WCK/IDF statements remain unconfirmed.

title: Israeli strikes kill at least three in Gaza, including an UNRWA worker
detail: Al Jazeera reports Israeli strikes, including a drone strike, killed at least three people in Gaza on Nov 23, among them an UNRWA worker. Further details and any IDF statement were not available at time of writing.

media.caption: Israeli strike kills UNRWA worker in Gaza
